args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail (great weekend hike)
args.body:
Hi Frank,

I wanted to recommend Cascade Falls Trail in the national park — it’s perfect for weekend hikes. It’s about 3 miles round trip and offers beautiful waterfall views along the way. A great short, scenic outing.

If you’d like, I can send directions or suggest the best times to go.

Best regards,

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class — Wednesday Evening
args.body:
Hi Eve,

I’d like to invite you to join me for a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week on Wednesday evening. It’s a practical, hands-on session where we’ll prepare and taste classic Italian dishes — should be a lot of fun.

Would love for you to join. Can you make it? Please let me know and I’ll share the details.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Calm meditation app
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I wanted to recommend the Calm meditation app — it’s great for stress relief and includes guided meditation sessions, breathing exercises, and sleep stories to help with relaxation and better rest. I’ve found the guided sessions especially helpful for managing stress.

Thought you might find it useful. Let me know if you want any tips on getting started.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Grace,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM, so if you go early you’ll get a really fresh loaf. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re nearby.

Best,
